title: Weekly dengue cases and satellite exposures, municipalities of Rio de Janeiro state, 2024

licence.note: Stated on the Zenodo record. The boundaries are CC BY 3.0 IGO, stated by geoBoundaries. InfoDengue's own terms, the origin of the counts, were not found.

derivation: Rows of dataset_multimodal_v8.parquet with estado RJ and anio 2024; 18 of 87 columns; read with hyparquet; values as published, data_iniSE written as a date. Boundaries: each of the dataset's 92 municipality names matched exactly to a geoBoundaries ADM2 name, the unit nearest the Rio de Janeiro state outline kept where 2 or 3 units share a name (7 names); coordinates rounded to 6 decimals.

verification.cases: 426,479 in all rows; 423,795 without the week starting 2024-12-29

findings: SE 202501, the week starting 2024-12-29, appears twice for every municipality, labelled semana 1 and anio 2024; the two rows differ only in precip_total_semana, one of them 0.
LST_Day_mean, LST_Night_mean, NDVI_mean and EVI_mean take 11 or 12 distinct values per municipality over the year: monthly values repeated weekly.
n_pixels is about 438 m² a pixel over Rio de Janeiro city, not MODIS's 1 km; which layer it counts is not stated.
LST_Day_mean is empty in 20 rows and LST_Night_mean in 128.
geoBoundaries' state file spells Rio de Janeiro "Rio de Jeneiro".
limits: Notified cases as InfoDengue reports them, not confirmed infections.
The exposure columns were computed by the dataset's authors by a method this file does not state.
